summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by Booking Holdings Inc. on May 7, 2026, reporting entry into a material definitive agreement—specifically, a contract for a new senior notes offering. The filing details multiple series of senior notes due from 2026 to 2046, but does not disclose any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event. The document is a routine disclosure of a debt financing arrangement and includes no shareholder vote, board recommendation, or transaction-specific terms such as price per share or premium. As such, this filing does not qualify as a special situation under any defined category.
